Eqva | Leading Sustainable Solutions for Industrial Services
Eqva specializes in acquiring and developing niche industrial companies, delivering safe, sustainable, and efficient services to drive the green transition in industrial sectors.

EQVA is a full-service provider of industrial services, built on development and long-term ownership of strong and complementary industrial companies. EQVA’s customers include leading industrial players across smelting operations, process industry, aquaculture, the maritime sector, and offshore. The Group’s core competencies span engineering services and mechanical solutions, steel structures, piping and tank systems, ventilation, power and automation, as well as the development and operation of hydropower plants. EQVA combines organic growth with targeted acquisitions to strengthen cash flow, core operations, and its geographical footprint. Portfolio companies operate with a high degree of autonomy, within clearly defined frameworks for governance, reporting, and shared support functions. This model enables efficient operations, economies of scale, and the realization of synergies – while preserving close proximity to customers and end markets. EQVA’s asset-light model and strong focus on cash generation support an attractive capital structure and enable profitable growth over time. With more than 750 specialized employees and a strong presence across several of Norway’s key indus

explanation.text:
EQVA ASA (org.nr 980 832 708) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1999-06-02, registered 1999-06-22. Business address: Sunde industriområde 3, 5450 SUNDE I SUNNHORDLAND. Main industry (NACE): 30.110 Bygging av sivile skip og flytende materiell. Registered employees: 6 (as of 2026-04-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 524,648; operating result NOK -39,524,619; net result NOK -32,934,061; total assets NOK 451,962,813; equity NOK 259,954,753 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 1,281,155,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Olav Hilmar Koløy; board chair Ingrid Marie Due-Gundersen; 6 other board members. Sub-units registered: 4. The website describes the company as: "Eqva specializes in acquiring and developing niche industrial companies, delivering safe, sustainable, and efficient services to drive the green transition in industrial sectors." LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXH9Q807 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Havyard_Group.
